items.t: China's Rayshine Studio Debuts New Hand-Drawn Fantasy Game at gamescom
items.s: Chinese indie developer Rayshine Studio unveiled The Order of Falling Stars, a hand-drawn fantasy adventure, at gamescom 2026, launching October 9 on PC, Switch 2 and PS5 for about $14. The game blends Chinese ink-wash art with action combat.

items.t: Jonathan Blow's New Puzzle Epic 'Order of the Sinking Star' Priced at 98 Yuan
items.s: Legendary designer Jonathan Blow's next game, Order of the Sinking Star, arrives October 9 on PC, Switch 2 and PS5. Its China price of 98 yuan highlights how global studios now court Chinese players with regional pricing.
